cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. The registry gives e-RCEV's coverage of all centres as proposed. UNICEF's 2024 brief says all 165 conservatories are digitised (MOZ-006), but the registry's own 2026 page, the newer source, still gives coverage of all centres as proposed.
cells.note: Lowered: the 2023 source describes an online request portal, while the registry's own 2026 page gives coverage of all centres as proposed and real-time registration was piloted in 19 facilities in 2024.
